projects.title: Raspberry Pi - Apache Tomcat Server

projects.title: SouthEastCon 2014 - Hardware Competition
projects.description: The SouthEastCon 2014 Hardware Competition is a competition between various school's robots. This year's competition will require the teams to be able to build a robot that is able to find a blue square and fire a dart at a target in three different locations and end in the square with more points being obtained from the amount of time left.

organizations.name: IEEE

organizations.name: IEEE
